name: dotnet-testing-filesystem-testing-abstractions

Test file/path operations via `System.IO.Abstractions`: inject `IFileSystem` (exposes `File`, `Directory`, `FileInfo`, `DirectoryInfo`, `Path`, `DriveInfo`) to test file-processing services without real-disk side effects, races, or environment-dependent errors.

```xml
<PackageReference Include="System.IO.Abstractions" Version="21.*" />
<PackageReference Include="System.IO.Abstractions.TestingHelpers" Version="21.*" />
```

Register with `services.AddSingleton<IFileSystem, FileSystem>();` and `services.AddScoped<ConfigService>();`. Use `MockFileSystem` to seed files/directories and verify reads, writes, copies, metadata (`Name`, `Size`), backups, and line counts.
